summary: Validated the two latest Interim edge-cases (reason-mandatory timesheet rejection + future-date blocking) against preview backend on servispro_dev. 8/8 pytest cases pass. Frontend code-review of CompanyInterimTab.js + TimesheetCalendar.js confirms parity with backend rules; a full Playwright UI run was attempted but the second navigation to /auth had a flaky phone-input timeout — backend coverage is the authoritative validation here.

minor.issue: Future date error message localized to French ('date future'). Confirmed to match spec; just noting clients should match on 400+contain 'future' rather than exact string.

action_items: No fix required for the new behaviours — backend already enforces both rules cleanly (HTTPException 400 with explicit French messages). Recommend the main agent run a quick manual UI smoke (login as +224620200001, Intérim → Pointages → Rejeter → empty/short/valid) to visually confirm the toast wording, since the automated Playwright run could not reliably reach the modal due to flaky DOM rehydration on the public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: interim_phase2.py reject_timesheet now correctly guards status=='submitted' AND reason length >=5 — both new requirements satisfied. Good.

interim_phase2.py submit_timesheet: future-date check is placed AFTER mission window check, so user-friendly messages may collide. Example: a date outside mission window AND in the future will only ever report 'date après la fin de la mission' — minor UX nit, not a defect.

TimesheetCalendar.js: future detection uses string comparison `dateStr(d) > todayIso` which is safe for ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD. Good. The disabled+amber+cursor-not-allowed class chain is applied consistently with `disabled={!valid}` on the button so click handlers are no-ops — matches backend enforcement.
CompanyInterimTab.js submitRejectTs: client-side length<5 check uses .trim() — consistent with backend which also trims. Toast error then early-return keeps modal open — exactly the spec.
Suggestion (non-blocking): the reject modal has no <DialogFooter> wrapper and the textarea is not focused on open; consider auto-focus to match spec phrasing 'elegant Shadcn modal' polish.

success_rate.frontend: code-review only (UI run aborted on second login navigation due to flaky element rendering — not a frontend bug, attempted twice)

seed_data_creation: Tests reuse the existing closed mission where Mamadou is accepted on servispro_dev. The _ensure_submitted_ts helper resets a previously rejected/validated timesheet back to 'submitted' via direct Mongo write so all 5 rejection scenarios can run repeatedly. No new persistent test data leaked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_interim_phase3_validations.py (Phase 3 edge-cases). Combine with test_interim_phase2.py (Phase 2) + test_interim.py (Phase 1) for full Interim coverage. The fixture closed_mission_with_provider auto-creates a chain if no closed mission with Mamadou accepted exists, and forces status=='closed' via direct DB write when the API endpoint is missing.
rca of the issue: N/A — both new behaviours pass. Reject endpoint correctly returns 400 for reason<5 chars (empty/short/no-body) and 400 for re-rejecting an already-rejected timesheet. Submit endpoint correctly returns 400 mentioning 'future' for tomorrow's date, 200 for today and 200 for past dates within mission window.
